title: CISA tries to contain data leak
summary: Krebs on Security reports on CISA attempting to contain a significant data leak incident, with members of Congress demanding official explanations and accountability regarding the breach.
problem_solved: Reports on CISA's efforts to contain and respond to a data leak while addressing Congressional inquiries about the incident.
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of government cybersecurity accountability and the need for transparency when sensitive data is compromised.
